scoreObj.top_issue: The creator repeatedly teases and promises more exclusive content without actually sending another PPV, causing the fan to become frustrated and threaten to leave, as seen in 'this next one's me lettin loose even more, super personal and wilder than before just for u' with no follow-up delivery.
scoreObj.fix_recommendation: Update the prompt to require sending a PPV immediately after any tease or promise of specific content to prevent stalling. Emphasize in the persona guidelines the importance of quick delivery on promises to match high-spender expectations and sustain engagement.
